title: Finding fresh meaning through shared action

captions.energy: Wanting to express a shared idea

meaning: Open action together can reveal a meaningful wish when delight in the result allows deeper understanding of why you began.
text: Sometimes a simple shared action lets you hear something important about your own choice. The Sun in the physical position of Manipura describes clear participation: saying what you are doing, joining in together and allowing the result to become visible. The Sun in energy identifies the motive, expressing a shared idea and enjoying it together. Judgement in emotions brings an inward awakening: behind one undertaking, a wish appears that you want to answer seriously. Clarity of action, the desire for expression and significant realisation belong to different aspects of your shared will.

For example, you record stories about favourite places for a small family album. Discussing photographs, you realise you want to preserve stories that usually pass between other things. **The meaning of a shared decision can become clearer through action.** A few openly told memories give the next step a foundation. You need not turn the discovery into a large project immediately; what matters is what you both heard in the experience.

The difficulty is requiring every successful idea to become an important beginning. Simple enjoyment must immediately establish a larger purpose, and doubt sounds like rejection of that meaning. Trying freely becomes harder. Realisation supports shared will better when allowed to develop without a hurried promise. One good experience can retain value before you know its place in later decisions.
